version.changelog: Names SEOmatic and the approve-first rule; exact tool and task names.

llm.summary: This skill is a coherent SEO indexing assistant that uses SEOmatic and Google Search Console data, with changes staged for user approval rather than applied silently.

dimensions.detail: Access to site pages, GSC performance/indexing data, audits, and task staging is proportionate to diagnosing and fixing indexing issues.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: It requires connecting the SEOmatic MCP server with OAuth or a Bearer API key, which is disclosed in the skill metadata and setup text.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions are scoped to user-requested indexing checks and explicitly require real Search Console data, plain reporting, and user approval before acting.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Staged tasks persist in SEOmatic and approved tasks may execute, but the artifact says nothing goes live until approval, destructive tasks need explicit confirmation, and approval must not be done on the user's behalf.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill's tools and instructions align with its stated purpose: inspecting indexing status, sitemaps, canonicals, robots/noindex signals, and staging SEO fixes.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, confirm you trust SEOmatic with your Search Console and site SEO data. Use OAuth if possible, review every staged task before approval, and pay special attention to robots.txt, noindex, redirect, and canonical changes because they can affect search visibility.
